locations.note: In an alternate steampunk 1886 London, Galahad and the Knights of the Round Table fight half-breeds and meet the Lycans in the Underground.
The opening fight is in Mayfair, and the United India Company's headquarters is here later.
The rebel headquarters is raided in Whitechapel, which the game visits twice.
The abandoned Royal London Hospital serves as the rebels' headquarters.
The airship Agamemnon crashes in Hyde Park, destroying the Crystal Palace, which the game places there.
The council chambers are in the Palace of Westminster.
The rebels attack on Westminster Bridge.
Vampires are shipped out from the United India Company warehouses at Blackwall.
